t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit, 7mm x 100mm, is a versatile drilling solution for trade professionals. This robust Milwaukee drill bit is impact-rated, making it suitable for impact drivers, rotary drill/drivers, and percussion drills, ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders on various jobsites. Its tungsten-carbide-tipped construction ensures effective penetration into concrete, bricks, roof tiles, wood, and thin metal. The hex shank provides secure driving and prevents slippage in the chuck, while the white flute aids quick identification. This durable 7mm drill bit offers precise drilling across a wide range of building materials.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
